summary: Trojanized @ornikar/eslint-config-babel drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload at install
details: The package's package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temporary directory, extracts and chmods it executable, then invokes it against the bundled `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, shuffled string-array rotator, large numeric constant tables) that is not referenced from the package's ESLint entry points (`index.js`, `_shared.js`, `rules/`). setup.mjs itself uses `_0xXXXX` variable-name obfuscation. The remainder of the tarball is a legitimate-looking ESLint configuration matching the ornikar-scoped project, serving as cover for the install-time dropper. Fetching a second language runtime at install and using it to execute an opaque, obfuscated sibling bundle is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose (an ESLint config) and constitutes install-time code execution of unverifiable content on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
